title: Rocket Five Four Three | Kashmiri Kids Song for Toddlers | BuBu TV - Kashmiri
description:
A cheerful Kashmiri rhyme about a cardboard rocket that takes us up to the sky to say hello to the sun!
Counting down from five to one helps little ones learn numbers while they sing and clap.
Hold tight, zoom off, and wave good morning to the stars with us!

Tara, Tara, wuth na,
KarDBoard rocket chhu hey vanan,
Beep, beep, beep, khirki chha chamakan,
Hello, hello, Tara chha aamut!

Five, four, three, two, one,
Zoor saan pakdo, gazho chalo,
Woosh, woosh, woosh, Tara chha duran,
Upar aasmanas manz!

Abran paraa uddu asi,
Safed te narm pambah hishah,
Zoom, zoom, zoom, surya chhu vuchhan,
"Good morning" vanan surya hath halawan!

Five, four, three, two, one,
Zoor saan pakdo, gazho chalo,
Woosh, woosh, woosh, Tara chha duran,
Upar aasmanas manz!

BoR boye, zhoot been, hath pakdiyo,
Asi sati uddan parinda ganzariyo,
Akh, ze, tri, zur, panzh parinda,
Chin chin, chin chin, hurray!

Five, four, three, two, one,
Zoor saan pakdo, gazho chalo,
Woosh, woosh, woosh, Tara chha duran,
Upar aasmanas manz!

Tal chhi gazhan, par chhi naman,
Halkah halkah, gaas sy peth,
Woosh, woosh, woosh, utro asi,
Hurray, hurray, hurray, baagh chhu asi hund!
